title: Constraining the magnetic field strength of a flaring radio core in the compact steep spectrum source 3C 138
question: Estimate the synchrotron self-absorption (SSA) magnetic field ($B_{\rm SSA}$) in the SSA core of the compact steep spectrum quasar 3C 138 during its high state and compare it with the equipartition magnetic field ($B_{\rm eq}$) to assess the core field environment.

what.value: ALMA Calibrator Source Catalogue flux estimates (approximately 97.5-343 GHz)

evidence.quote: We also used the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) Calibrator Source Catalogue (cite: kneissl2023operational), which provides well-calibrated flux estimates for standard ALMA calibrators, thereby extending our spectral coverage to the millimeter/submillimeter regime (approximately $97.5$–$343$ GHz).

evidence.loc: Size scaling for the SSA region
evidence.quote: We adopt $k_{\rm r}=1$ as a commonly used empirical value in core-shift scaling (cite: lobanov1998ultracompact), and the median $\epsilon$ value of 0.97 from (cite: algaba2017resolving).

what.value: Equipartition brightness temperature T_B,eq = 5 x 10^10 K

evidence.quote: Here we adopt $T_{\rm B,eq}=5\times10^{10}$ K (cite: hovatta2009).

recipe.goal: Calibrate, image, and model-fit KVN and VLBA visibilities
recipe.method: Calibrate KVN visibilities with AIPS KVN pipeline; perform interferometric imaging and circular 2D Gaussian model fitting in Difmap for KVN and VLBA epochs.
key_parameters: Two circular Gaussian components (W and E) separated by ~5 mas
assumptions: Flux density uncertainties of 10% (22/43 GHz), 20% (86 GHz), and 30% (129 GHz)

recipe.goal: Fit component spectra and broadband VLA+ALMA spectra
recipe.method: Fit KVN eastern component with a power law (PL) and western component with a single-zone SSA model. Interpolate ALMA Calibrator Catalogue flux densities with Gaussian-process (GP) regression, pair with four VLA epochs, and fit combined VLA+ALMA spectra with PL and PL+SSA models.
assumptions: Single-zone homogeneous synchrotron self-absorption model for the core

recipe.goal: Estimate SSA core size, variability Doppler factor, and magnetic field strengths
recipe.method: Scale 23.5 GHz VLBA core size to the SSA turnover frequency to get d_m; fit VLBA core light curve in log space to get variability timescale tau_var, T_B^var, and delta_var; compute B_SSA and B_eq and propagate uncertainties via Monte Carlo sampling.
key_parameters: d_VLBA = 0.06 +/- 0.01 mas, k_r = 1, epsilon = 0.97, T_B,eq = 5 x 10^10 K, eta = 1
assumptions: Cosmology: H_0 = 67.8 km s^-1 Mpc^-1, Omega_m = 0.308, Omega_Lambda = 0.692
Factor 1.6 converts Gaussian FWHM to uniform disk angular diameter; eta = 1 for ratio of proton+electron to electron energy densities

answer_key.quantity: KVN SSA core peak flux density
